concepts.label: vBucket takeover
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the mechanism by which a vBucket's DCP/TAP stream ownership moves from source to destination node during rebalance. Placed in the vbucket: namespace (alongside the already-promoted vbucket:active-vbucket and vbucket:replica-vbucket) rather than server:, per this round's naming guidance to reuse existing namespaces. Introduced here because this page's producer/notifier stream-state enum includes takeover-send and takeover-wait, and the same mechanism is the whole topic of cbstats-dcp-vbtakeover.md and cbstats-tap-vbtakeover.md, also in this batch.

relations.subject: protocol:dcp

relations.subject: protocol:dcp
relations.evidence: DCP provides statistics for consumer, producer, and notifier connection types.

relations.subject: vbucket:vbucket-takeover
relations.evidence: state | The stream state (pending, backfilling, in-memory, takeover-send, takeover-wait, or dead)

notable_absence.finding: The stream-state enum lists takeover-send and takeover-wait as ordinary DCP producer states but never explains what 'takeover' means, or that it corresponds to a distinct cbstats subcommand (dcp-vbtakeover) elsewhere in this same directory - a reader of this page alone has no way to connect the two.

cross_component_finding: The producer/notifier stream-state enum ('pending, backfilling, in-memory, takeover-send, takeover-wait, or dead') shows that vBucket takeover during rebalance is implemented as a distinguished DCP stream state rather than a separate protocol, directly tying this page to cbstats-dcp-vbtakeover.md and cbstats-tap-vbtakeover.md in this same batch. AUTHORSHIP-PROVENANCE CONTRAST: unlike those two commands, which state explicitly 'This command is used by cluster manager (ns_server) to track the progress of rebalance using DCP/TAP', this page never names who consumes DCP connection statistics - administrator, cluster manager, and XDCR are all plausible callers of the ep_dcpq:* stats it exposes, but the page attributes ownership to none of them. cbstats-dcp.md is anonymous about its consumer; cbstats-dcp-vbtakeover.md and cbstats-tap-vbtakeover.md are explicit.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - this page's DCP is purely Couchbase Server's intra-cluster streaming protocol; the Sync-Gateway-adjacent replication vocabulary from rounds 27-28 (ISGR, sgw:bidirectional-xdcr) is a different mechanism on a different product and is not referenced or implied here.
